title: Find the limit that stops a run
heading: Each Limit Answers a Different Question
cases: a relative gap tolerance stops the run at the first row whose gap is within it
a solution limit stops the run at the first row whose count reaches it
when a gap tolerance and a node limit are met on the same row, the gap rule is the one named
an absolute tolerance stops the run on its own, before the relative tolerance is met
a node count equal to the limit meets it
a row with no plan yet cannot meet a gap rule, however small its bound
a trace in which no rule is met gives (None, None)
